label: The Economist Democracy Index
description: Measures the state of democracy based on electoral process, civil liberties, functioning of government, political participation, and political culture. Published by the Economist Group.

label: Control of Corruption Index
description: Reflects perceptions of the extent to which public power is exercised for private gain, including petty and grand forms of corruption.

label: Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI)
description: The Corruption Perceptions Index ranks countries by their perceived levels of public sector corruption, as determined by expert assessments and opinion surveys.

label: Press Freedom Index
description: Evaluates the level of freedom available to journalists based on pluralism, media independence, environment, self-censorship, legislation, and infrastructure.

label: Rule of Law Index
description: Measures adherence to rule of law principles including accountability, just laws, open government, and accessible and impartial dispute resolution.

label: Human Rights Protection Score
description: Measures the degree to which human rights are protected, including civil liberties, physical integrity rights, and political rights.

label: GDP
description: Gross Domestic Product - the total monetary value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific time period.

label: Annual GDP Growth
description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency. Shows how fast the economy is expanding or contracting.

label: GDP per Capita
description: GDP divided by midyear population. Provides a per-person measure of economic output, useful for comparing living standards between countries.

label: GDP per Capita (PPP)
description: GDP per capita adjusted for Purchasing Power Parity. Accounts for price differences between countries, providing a more accurate comparison of living standards.

label: Debt to GDP Ratio
description: The ratio of a country's public debt to its GDP. Indicates the country's ability to pay back its debt without incurring further debt.

label: Inflation
description: Annual percentage change in consumer price index. Measures how quickly prices for goods and services are rising and purchasing power is declining.

label: Unemployment Rate
description: Share of the labor force that is without work but available and seeking employment. A key indicator of labor market health.

label: Gini Coefficient
description: Measures income inequality within a country. Shows how evenly wealth is distributed among the population.

label: Foreign Direct Investment (Net Inflows)
description: Net inflows of investment to acquire a lasting management interest in an enterprise operating in an economy other than that of the investor.

label: Trade (% of GDP)
description: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services measured as a share of GDP. Indicates how open and integrated an economy is with the rest of the world.

label: Exports (% of GDP)
description: Exports of goods and services as a share of GDP. Measures how much of a country's economic output is sold to other countries.

label: Gross Savings (% of GDP)
description: Gross savings as percentage of GDP. Calculated as gross national income less total consumption, plus net transfers.

label: Current Account Balance (% of GDP)
description: Sum of net exports of goods and services, net primary income, and net secondary income. A positive value indicates a surplus.

label: Internet Users (% of Population)
description: Percentage of the population using the Internet. Includes users who accessed the Internet from any device in the last 3 months.

label: Share Using Internet (OWID)
description: Share of individuals using the Internet, sourced from Our World in Data. Measures digital connectivity and access to information.

label: Mobile Subscriptions (per 100 people)
description: Number of mobile cellular telephone subscriptions per 100 people. Can exceed 100 as individuals may have multiple subscriptions.

label: Fixed Broadband Subscriptions (per 100 people)
description: Fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people. Refers to high-speed fixed Internet subscriptions at 256 kbit/s or faster.

label: R&D Expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Expenditures for research and development as a percentage of GDP. Includes basic research, applied research, and experimental development.

label: Patent Applications (Residents)
description: Number of patent applications filed by residents of the country. An indicator of innovation capacity and technological development.

label: High-Technology Exports (% of Manufactured)
description: High-technology exports as a percentage of manufactured exports. Includes products with high R&D intensity like aerospace, computers, and electronics.

label: ICT Goods Exports (% of Total)
description: Information and communication technology goods exports as a percentage of total goods exports. Includes telecom, audio/video, computer equipment, and components.

label: Secure Internet Servers (per million)
description: Number of secure Internet servers (using encryption technology) per million people. Indicates digital infrastructure maturity.

label: Education Expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Government expenditure on education as a percentage of GDP. Includes spending on schools, universities, and educational administration.

label: Literacy Rate (Adult)
description: Percentage of people ages 15 and above who can read and write a short, simple statement about their everyday life.

label: Literacy Rate (Youth)
description: Percentage of people ages 15-24 who can read and write. Indicates the effectiveness of recent education systems.

label: School Enrollment - Primary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio in primary education. Total enrollment regardless of age as a percentage of the officially eligible school-age population.

label: School Enrollment - Secondary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio in secondary education. Indicates access to and participation in secondary schooling.

label: School Enrollment - Tertiary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio in tertiary education (universities and colleges). Shows access to higher education.

label: Pupil-Teacher Ratio (Primary)
description: Average number of pupils per teacher in primary school. Lower ratios generally indicate better quality of education.

label: Learning-Adjusted Years of School
source: World Bank / Our World in Data
description: Number of years of schooling adjusted for actual learning. Combines quantity (years) and quality (test scores) of education.

label: Life Expectancy
description: Average number of years a newborn would live if current mortality patterns were to remain constant. Key indicator of overall health and development.

label: Hospital Beds (per 1,000 people)
description: Number of hospital beds per 1,000 people. Includes inpatient beds available in public, private, general, and specialized hospitals.

label: Physicians (per 1,000 people)
description: Number of medical doctors (generalist and specialist) per 1,000 people. Indicates the availability of medical care.

label: Nurses & Midwives (per 1,000 people)
description: Number of nursing and midwifery personnel per 1,000 people. Critical for primary healthcare and maternal/child health.

label: Health Expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Current health expenditure as a percentage of GDP. Includes both public and private spending on health services and goods.

label: Health Expenditure per Capita
description: Current health expenditure per capita in US dollars. Shows how much is spent on health per person.

label: Immunization - Measles (%)
description: Percentage of children ages 12-23 months who received measles vaccination. A key indicator of immunization program coverage.

label: Immunization - DPT (%)
description: Percentage of children ages 12-23 months who received DPT (diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus) vaccination.

label: Under-5 Mortality Rate
description: Probability that a newborn baby will die before reaching age 5, expressed per 1,000 live births.

label: Child Mortality Rate
description: Share of children who die before reaching age 5. Long-run historical estimates of child mortality.

label: Maternal Mortality Ratio
description: Number of women who die from pregnancy-related causes per 100,000 live births. Reflects access to quality maternal healthcare.

label: Birth Rate (per 1,000)
description: Crude birth rate - number of live births per 1,000 population in a given year.

label: Death Rate (per 1,000)
description: Crude death rate - number of deaths per 1,000 population in a given year.

label: COâ‚‚ Emissions per Capita
description: Annual carbon dioxide emissions per person measured in tonnes. Includes emissions from fossil fuels, industry, and land use.

label: COâ‚‚ Emissions (Total)
description: Total annual carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuels, industry, and land use, measured in million tonnes.

label: Greenhouse Gas Emissions per Capita
description: Total greenhouse gas emissions per capita including COâ‚‚, methane, nitrous oxide, and F-gases measured in tonnes of COâ‚‚ equivalents.

label: Forest Area (% of Land)
description: Percentage of total land area covered by forest. Forests are land spanning over 0.5 hectares with trees taller than 5 meters.

label: Renewable Energy Consumption (%)
description: Share of renewable energy in total final energy consumption. Includes hydropower, solar, wind, geothermal, and biomass.

label: Renewable Electricity Output (%)
description: Percentage of total electricity output generated from renewable sources including hydro, solar, wind, and geothermal.

label: Renewables (% Primary Energy)
description: Share of primary energy that comes from renewable sources. Measures the overall transition away from fossil fuels.

label: Renewables (% Electricity)
description: Share of electricity generated from renewable sources including hydro, wind, solar, biomass, wave, tidal, and geothermal.

label: Nuclear Energy (% Electricity)
description: Share of electricity generated from nuclear power. Nuclear provides carbon-free baseload power.

label: Access to Electricity (%)
description: Percentage of population with access to electricity. Critical for development, health, education, and economic growth.

label: PM2.5 Air Pollution (Âµg/mÂ³)
description: Mean annual exposure to PM2.5 air pollution. Fine particulate matter of 2.5 micrometers or less that can penetrate deep into the lungs.

label: Arable Land (% of Land Area)
description: Percentage of total land area that is arable - land under temporary crops, temporary meadows, land under market/kitchen gardens, and temporarily fallow land.

label: Access to Clean Fuels (%)
description: Percentage of population with primary reliance on clean fuels and technologies for cooking. Reduces indoor air pollution health risks.

label: Population
description: Total number of people residing in a country. Based on de facto definition counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.

label: Fertility Rate
description: Total fertility rate - the average number of children a woman would have over her lifetime. Rate of 2.1 is considered replacement level.

label: Median Age
description: The age that divides the population into two numerically equal groups - half are younger, half are older. Indicates the overall age structure.

label: Urbanization Rate
description: Percentage of total population living in urban areas. Reflects the degree of industrialization and development patterns of a country.

label: Human Development Index
description: The Human Development Index (HDI) is a summary measure of key dimensions of human development: a long and healthy life, a good education, and a decent standard of living.

label: Self-reported Life Satisfaction
description: Based on the Cantril Self-Anchoring Scale where respondents rate their current life on a ladder from 0 (worst) to 10 (best possible life).

label: Poverty Ratio (Extreme Poverty %)
description: Share of population living below the international poverty line. Measures the extent of extreme deprivation in a country.

label: Homicide Rate
description: Intentional homicides per 100,000 people. Includes murder and manslaughter but excludes deaths from war. Indicates public safety and social stability.

label: Military Expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Military expenditure as a share of GDP. Includes spending on armed forces, defense ministry, paramilitary forces, and military space activities.

label: Military Expenditure (Total)
description: Total military expenditure in current US dollars. Includes all spending on current military forces and activities.

label: Terrorism Deaths
description: Total number of people killed in terrorist attacks per year. Includes all recorded terrorist incidents.

label: Gender Inequality Index
description: The Gender Inequality Index reflects gender-based disadvantage in three dimensions â€“ reproductive health, empowerment and the labour market.

label: Female Labor Force Participation (%)
description: Percentage of female population ages 15+ that is economically active. Indicates women's economic empowerment and gender equality.

label: Women in Parliament (%)
description: Percentage of parliamentary seats held by women. Reflects women's political representation and empowerment.

label: Female Enrollment - Tertiary (%)
description: Gross enrollment ratio for females in tertiary education. Shows gender equity in access to higher education.

label: Safe Sanitation Access (%)
description: Percentage of population using safely managed sanitation services. Includes flush toilets connected to sewers, septic tanks, or treatment plants.

label: Population Growth Rate
description: Annual population growth rate expressed as a percentage. Based on the de facto definition of population.

label: Logistics Performance Index
description: Overall score reflecting perceptions of a country's logistics based on customs, infrastructure, international shipments, logistics competence, tracking, and timeliness.

label: Consumer Price Index (2010=100)
description: Consumer price index reflecting changes in the cost of acquiring a fixed basket of goods and services. Base year 2010 = 100.

label: Human Capital Index
description: Measures the amount of human capital that a child born today can expect to attain by age 18, given the risks of poor health and education in the country.

label: PISA Reading Score
description: PISA mean performance on the reading scale. PISA assesses the extent to which 15-year-old students have acquired key knowledge and skills in reading, math, and science.

label: Homicide Rate (UNODC)
description: Intentional homicide rate per 100,000 population as reported by UNODC. Provides a standardized measure of violent crime across countries.

label: Water Stress Level (%)
description: Freshwater withdrawal as a proportion of available freshwater resources. Higher values indicate greater stress on water resources.

label: Safe Drinking Water Access (%)
description: Percentage of population using safely managed drinking water services. Water from an improved source located on premises, available when needed, and free from contamination.
